verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own AI agents (screening and transaction-monitoring agentic workflows), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions connecting MCP servers or extending the agents with external tools. The Starter Plan states agent configurations are standardized and cannot be customized. The llms.txt, OpenAPI schema and webhooks serve outside consumers, not MCP-client capability.
